subject: Credits interop, billing tranche & pricing override request
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@asterlabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credits interop proposal + attached matrix

Hi Maria — great to meet yesterday. Following up with a concrete packaging proposal so your procurement team has something to review. I attached a simple credit matrix (Aster_Credit_Matrix_v2.xlsx) that maps the sandbox stipend and promotional credits we discussed to two conversion paths. TL;DR:

- Offer: $12k promotional sandbox credits applied over 6 months.
- Conversion option: up to 50% of unused promo credits may be applied as a one-time credit toward a Dedicated capacity reservation (12-month commit) at a 15% uplift over face value (this is how we account for reserved-rate economics).
- Alternative: we can provide a one-time 10% sponsor discount on your first dedicated invoice instead of conversion (simpler for procurement).

Key asks from your side: whether procurement can accept credits applied to a future invoice (vs. cash payout), and whether Aster needs escrowed documentation for audit. If you prefer, we can split the credits per-product (Embeddings / Generation) or by team.

Next steps I propose: procurement reviews the attached matrix; if they want the conversion path we loop in finance for a short approval (Ben can coordinate). If simpler, sign the Sponsor Discount addendum and we bill the Dedicated reservation and apply the discount.

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Ben (ops/finance) and Irene (product partnerships) to help with approvals and wording.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@asterlabs.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@asterlabs.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits interop proposal + attached matrix

Hi Tessa — thanks for the note and the matrix. A few items from procurement and legal: 

- We cannot accept promotional credits that are convertible to cash. Any application to an invoice is fine, but we need an explicit line on the invoice showing applied credit and a PO referencing that credit.
- Escrow: we typically require a short attestation that credits are non-transferable and have an expiry.
- On the conversion uplift: 15% is reasonable, but we need to see the math that shows how that maps to committed GPU-hours (so our finance team can forecast).

Question: can Redwood apply credits across team-level sub-accounts? We have two engineering squads that will consume differently. If not, we'll ask to split the stipend now.

I can share a standard PO template (procurement@asterlabs.ai) — if you can return an invoice with the credit line, we can get internal approvals faster.

Thanks,
Maria Alvarez
Head of Ops, Aster Labs
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@asterlabs.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits interop proposal + attached matrix

Hi Maria — looping in finance. Quick responses to your bullets: 

- Invoice treatment: yes, we can show a line item for "Promotional credit applied" and reference the PO. That aligns with how we've handled similar accelerator partners.
- Escrow/attestation: we can provide a short statement (1 paragraph) describing credit scope, expiry (6 months), and non-transferability; I attached a redline (RDW-2049-term-exception-redline.pdf) with the proposed language.
- Conversion math: attached matrix includes a column that converts credit dollars to estimated GPU-hours under two usage profiles (low / high). If you share rough QPS or monthly token estimates I can refine the mapping.

On the convert-to-dedicated option: finance needs a signed deal (deal id RDW-2049) and an internal approval for the 15% uplift conversion. If procurement prefers to avoid the conversion complexity, the sponsor-discount path (10% off first invoice) is administratively simpler and we can ship that today.

We can also support splitting credits across two sub-accounts; we'll need the account IDs before we apply.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: finance-approvals@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Maria Alvarez <maria@asterlabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promotional credits interop exception for Aster Labs (RDW-2049)

Team — requesting a one-time exception to allow partial conversion of promotional credits (up to 50%) to a Dedicated reservation credit at 15% uplift for Aster Labs. Rationale:

- Aster is a strategic early-stage partner (accelerator-backed) with high potential for expansion to dedicated capacity within 6–12 months.
- Allowing conversion smooths the path to committed revenue and is a better economic outcome than a pure sponsor discount.
- Procurement requires invoice-level credit application and a short escrow attestation; Ben has prepared the redline and the credit-to-GPU mapping.

Requested approvals: finance sign-off for the 15% uplift conversion and legal quick review of the RDW-2049 redline (attached). If we cannot secure approvals in 48 hours, fallback to the simpler Sponsor Discount (10% off first invoice) so we don't stall the PO.

Justification attachments: Aster_Credit_Matrix_v2.xlsx; RDW-2049-term-exception-redline.pdf.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Dir, Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@asterlabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, procurement@asterlabs.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits interop proposal + attached matrix

Maria — thanks for the quick responses and for sharing the PO template. To keep momentum, two immediate options: 

1) Conversion path (preferred by product/partnerships): sign the attached short addendum accepting the credit-to-dedicated conversion at 15% uplift, include the addendum reference on your PO, and Redwood will return an invoice showing "Promotional credit applied" line. Finance & Legal (cc'd) are processing approval now.

2) Sponsor Discount (fastest): we issue a 10% discount addendum for the first Dedicated invoice; no conversion math or escrow language required. This gets you on Dedicated quickly.

Please indicate which option procurement prefers. If you choose conversion we need: PO referencing RDW-2049, sub-account IDs for credit split (if any), and an estimate of monthly token usage so Ben can finalize the GPU-hours mapping.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call if that helps speed approvals.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
